entries.text: The start screen shows Redemption unlocked, not the greyed-out symbol
Richer terrain art and a spawn portal that faces the road it opens onto
A single run's road can now mix two shapes, like a serpentine into a staircase
Each run now rolls a unique road shape and a field of obstacles to build around
The interface now scales as far as the screen can actually hold, and no further
Each tower of the same type costs 15% more than the last
The road is a worn dirt track now, not a lane-marked highway
The DPS panel no longer reads as if support towers were the top damage dealer
A large interface size no longer overlaps the gold in the bottom bar
Monsters can now be weak to melee or ranged, not only to a spell
Draft card rarities now match how strong the card actually is
Draft cards you have never kept are badged NEW
Soul Eater is a mythic relic with a real appetite
Regenerating enemies can no longer get stuck alive forever
The interface only refreshes when something on it actually changed
The work-in-progress notice uses the dimmed Redemption heart
The work-in-progress notice wears the Redemption heart
A winged heart marks the work-in-progress notice
The start screen says the game is still being built
The gold pile grows with the purse
Scurrius sheds rats 50% more often
Scurrius shares his rats' weakness to Air
Scurrius stops to squeak, and his rats obey a stun
Scurrius takes the swarm axis
Stop ordinary waves sending a boss's adds as trash
Bake Scurrius's animation clips from the cache
Leash a returning rat to Scurrius so the refund is visible

Scurrius and his Giant rats join the roster
Scurrius shear maths — HP changes shape, never grows

The red that warns you is the bright one everywhere, not the maroon

Sort the custom-wave roster by name, bosses last
